title: Sathyameva, Law and Order and Octopus Head This Week's Malayalam and Tamil OTT Releases
excerpt: Three South Indian titles begin streaming on Friday, November 27, 2026: a Malayalam courtroom series and a Tamil mystery thriller on ZEE5, and a Malayalam police action film on Manorama MAX.
body:
• Three Malayalam and Tamil titles begin streaming on Friday, November 27, 2026: the Malayalam series Sathyameva and the Tamil thriller Octopus on ZEE5, and the Malayalam film Law and Order on Manorama MAX.
  • Sathyameva stars Rony David Raj as Advocate Rajaram, a lawyer haunted by a past failure who takes up the search for a woman who vanished 20 years ago.
  • Law and Order, directed by Ranjith, features a cameo by Mammootty reprising his role as Karikkamuri Shanmughan from the 2004 film Black; its November 27 date is listed as tentative.
  • All three are Malayalam- or Tamil-language releases — check the ZEE5 and Manorama MAX apps for availability in your country.

Malayalam and Tamil streaming premieres cluster on one day this week. On Friday, November 27, 2026, ZEE5 adds the Malayalam courtroom series Sathyameva and the Tamil mystery thriller Octopus, while Manorama MAX is set to release the Malayalam police action film Law and Order. Here is what each one is, who is in it, and where to watch.

"The trail leads through forgotten memories and hidden secrets to a web of deception involving influential figures."

Sathyameva is a six-episode Malayalam crime drama series directed by Deepu Karunakaran. Rony David Raj plays Advocate Rajaram, a once-successful lawyer haunted by his failure to save an innocent client, who gets a chance at redemption when he takes up the search for a woman who disappeared 20 years ago. The trail leads through forgotten memories and hidden secrets to a web of deception involving influential figures. The cast includes Meenakshi Unnikrishnan, Jayaraj Kozhikode, Remya Suresh and Meera Nair, with Karunakaran also appearing in a significant role. It streams on ZEE5 from November 27.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=nS3Q41OaVd0

Law and Order: Ranjith's police action drama

Law and Order is a Malayalam action drama directed by Ranjith. Prakash Varma plays Balagopal, an officer known for his integrity, who teams up with five young academy graduates to challenge a powerful underground network; after an unexpected tragedy, the rookies take matters into their own hands. The cast includes Limson K Sunny, Joy Mathew, Suresh Krishna, Abhirami, Shankar Ramakrishnan and VK Prakash. The headline draw is a cameo: Mammootty reprises his role as Karikkamuri Shanmughan from Ranjith's 2004 film Black. It is listed for Manorama MAX on November 27, with the date marked tentative.

Octopus: a Tamil mystery on ZEE5

Octopus is a Tamil mystery thriller directed by Jeyachandra Hashmi, starring Ashwin Kumar, Archana Ravichandran and Vinoth Kishan. Set in a close-knit neighbourhood where residents share a family-like bond, it revolves around the sudden disappearance of a young woman, which gradually uncovers secrets and hidden truths within the community. ZEE5 has released the official trailer ahead of its November 27 premiere.

How to watch

Sathyameva and Octopus stream on ZEE5 and Law and Order on Manorama MAX, all from Friday, November 27. For viewers in the US and other diaspora markets, both services carry their catalogues through their apps — search the title on release day to confirm it is available in your region.
